about_the_game:
A survival challenge game set in the doomsday zombie world.
In the game, day and night alternate. Zombies will not be active during the day, so you can build your home safely. At night, you have to resist hordes of zombies and guard your camp!
This is a light "simulation business (day)" + "strategy battle (night)" game, focusing on strategy and light operation, with some elements of meat pigeons. Each game is a different experience~ You can try different strategies and gameplay to challenge your own survival limit!



There are up to thirty types of zombies in the game, each with completely different special abilities. You need to decide your tactical ideas and play style based on the types of zombies that have appeared. If you ignore this, you may fall into a very passive situation.



Props and special materials are indispensable tactical items in the game. Sometimes, you have to decide your play style based on the props and special materials you have. At a critical moment, a small prop may determine the final outcome of the battle. Don't ignore these seemingly insignificant gadgets



There are more than ten professions for survivors, and each profession has its own unique talents. They will play completely different roles in the construction of the camp and in the battle. Make good use of the professional talent effects, and maybe your road to survival will not be so difficult



You can modify weapons or survivors to give weapons characteristics and survivors biochemical abilities. The weapons or survivors that have been transformed will gain new effects or abilities, which are especially important in the later battles.



The game is aimed at "survival challenge". You can challenge your own survival limit and survive as long as possible. At the same time, the game also provides two clearance methods: "normal clearance" and "perfect clearance". On the basis of survival, you need to do more to save those survivors.



We tried to make a game that can be quickly started and worth playing repeatedly through a simple method and lightweight scale. We have tried our best to enrich the strategy combinations with limited functions and content, and introduced a certain random mechanism to increase the uncertainty of the game.
Maybe we haven't done it well enough, but we hope it can bring you some different game fun~
